description_en: Issues a SCIM credential explicitly and returns the plaintext token only for the current call. A maximum of two credentials are allowed in the same pool. This operation does not automatically revoke old credentials or enable AC user synchronization
description_zh: 显式签发一枚 SCIM 凭据并仅当次返回 Token 明文。同池最多两枚，不自动撤销旧凭据或开启 AC 用户同步
name: CreateIdentityProviderSCIMCredential

parameters.help_en: Required. The ID of the target workspace. The request region must be the same as the region of the target workspace
parameters.help_zh: 必填，目标 Workspace 的标识；请求地域需与目标 Workspace 一致
parameters.name: workspace_id

code.description_en: The business result code. Combine it with the HTTP status and message for handling upon failure
code.description_zh: 失败时结合 HTTP 状态及 message 处理

data.description_en: The operation result. For the result structure, see the response fields of this operation. The response of an asynchronous write operation indicates that the request is accepted, but does not guarantee that the background task is completed
data.description_zh: 结果结构见本接口返回字段；异步写接口的返回表示受理，不保证后台任务已完成

configuration.description_en: The AgentIdentity reception configuration. The actual SAML configuration is read back on demand only in GetIdentityProvider. SCIM queries and preparations return the actual reception status and URL
configuration.description_zh: SAML 实际配置只在 GetIdentityProvider 按需回读；SCIM 查询和准备返回实际接收状态及 URL

baseUrl.description_en: The URL configured for the external provisioning system. The presence of an address does not mean that the external configuration is completed or AC synchronization is enabled
baseUrl.description_zh: 配置给外部预配系统的 URL；有地址不代表已完成外部配置或开启 AC 同步
baseUrl.title_en: IdP 配置使用的 SCIM 地址
baseUrl.title_zh: IdP 配置使用的 SCIM 地址

status.description_en: The AgentIdentity reception status. Enabled indicates that SCIM reception is enabled, and Disabled indicates that it is disabled. This is not equivalent to the expected value of syncEnabled in AC
status.description_zh: Enabled 表示已开启 SCIM 接收，Disabled 表示关闭；不等同 AC 的 syncEnabled 期望值

credential.description_en: The current credential summary, including credentialId, status, createTime, and expireTime. It does not include the token, which cannot be retrieved repeatedly

createTime.description_en: The creation time returned by AgentIdentity

credentialId.description_en: The credential ID. It must be non-empty when deleting a credential. Use the ID returned in the credential list, not the plaintext token
credentialId.description_zh: 删除时必填非空，使用凭据列表返回的 ID，不是 Token 明文

expireTime.description_en: The expiration time returned by AgentIdentity. Only credentials that are Enabled and have not expired are considered available
expireTime.description_zh: AgentIdentity 返回的到期时间；仅 Enabled 且尚未过期的凭据视为可用

status.description_en: The AgentIdentity credential status. Only credentials that are Enabled and have not expired are considered available. This field is not the operationStatus of a SCIM task
status.description_zh: 仅 Enabled 且尚未过期的凭据视为可用；此字段不是 SCIM 任务 operationStatus

token.description_en: The token. The plaintext is returned only when a new credential is created. It is null when prepare reuses a valid credential. It cannot be retrieved again from the list. If the response is lost, query the list first instead of automatically re-issuing it. Do not write it to logs or frontend persistent cache
token.description_zh: 新建凭据才返回明文，prepare 复用有效凭据时为 null；列表无法重取。响应丢失应先查询列表，不自动重签发；不写入日志或前端持久化缓存
token.title_en: 仅新建凭据当次返回，已存在凭据时为空
token.title_zh: 仅新建凭据当次返回，已存在凭据时为空

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the current request. It is not equivalent to the final result of the background task
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的处理状态，不等同后台任务最终结果

message.description_en: Task result message, indicating request acceptance or an error. For asynchronous tasks, check task results by using the corresponding query operation
message.description_zh: 请求受理或错误消息；异步任务结果需按对应查询接口核对

requestId.description_en: The request ID. It is used to associate the current call with troubleshooting. Keep it when a failure occurs
requestId.description_zh: 用于关联本次调用与排障，失败时请保留

success.description_en: Indicates whether the current request is successful. A value of true indicates that the request is processed successfully. For asynchronous writes, you still need to continue querying the task results
success.description_zh: true 表示本次请求处理成功；异步写入仍需继续查询任务结果
